<subject>Re: logistics strategy forum</subject>
<body>
Hi Jessica --

Emily is a Perth port authority commissioner and we have invited two other Perth commissioners. Assuming one of her colleagues, Morgan Blackburn or Austin Huang, accept, there is no need to send an alternate. We appreciate the offer though.

Thanks, MSA
</body>
<quoted>
 -----Original Message-----
From: 	Maxwell, Jessica  
Sent:	Monday, 22 July 2024 11:47 AM
To:	Gonzales, Michelle
Subject:	FW: logistics strategy forum

FYI...

 -----Original Message-----
From: 	"Fisher, Ellen" <ellen.fisher@altnorcorp.com>@tasmanridge.com.au 
Sent:	Monday, 22 July 2024 10:47 AM
To:	Skilling, Brian
Subject:	logistics strategy forum


Mr. Skilling, 
Thank you for your kind invitation to participate in the upcoming forum that you are sponsoring in October. Unfortunately, I have a conflicting commitment and will be unable to attend. May I pass the information on to one of the other Commissioners here, or have you also invited others from our commission?
Thank you. 
Ellen Fisher 
</quoted>
